activeSlice.scope: Restore the certified three-topic Hunter V2 shadow retrieval shape while keeping paid search cost at two Agent Reach calls: two core intents plus one exploration intent, with the unpaid core intent using the existing free RSS fallback. Enforce explorationMax=0.20 against the actual final recommendation count only in the operational shadow evidence profile, preserving generic EEI and learned-exploration semantics.
successCriteria: Operational V2 selects exactly three lexical intents when at least three discovery topics exist: two distinct core topics and one distinct exploration topic.
At most two intents are paid Agent Reach searches; an unpaid brand-core intent retains the existing RSS fallback so configured paid search cost remains at most $0.014 per candidate lane.
Operational retrieval may execute three intents but does not increase maxPaidIntents above 2.
Operational shadow evidence final exploration share never exceeds 0.20 based on the actual selected recommendation count, including sparse-output fallback cases.
Generic EEI calls keep existing explicit-exploration and feedback-learning behavior unless the operational final-share enforcement flag is enabled.
If sparse evidence makes the certified 0.08-0.20 exploration interval mathematically impossible, the run remains honestly rollout-blocking rather than fabricating recommendations.
The R5R11 model-pressure policy remains unchanged: deep-analysis concurrency 1 and 15-second inter-pair pacing.
No quality, retrieval, latency, cost, failure, exploration or topic-share rollout threshold changes.
Hunter V1 remains production authority; no V2 persistence, canary, scheduler or production enablement.
PES v2 CI and Security baseline pass before merge/deployment.
The same 3x3 pre-gate passes all non-sample-size gates before any 30-pair gate.

priorPreGateEvidence.reason: R5R11 eliminated benchmark 429 failures and made latency/cost healthy, but one sparse 4-item result produced 25% exploration and V2 quality remained below the unchanged -0.02 delta gate. Operational retrieval had been narrowed to one core plus one exploration intent despite the earlier certified two-core-plus-one-exploration contract.
